versions.changelog:
Initial release of the liveos-community skill:

- Supports working with the open LiveOS Community repository for public-screen live-commerce monitoring demos.
- Restricts usage to local demos, report generation, and integration interface discussions.
- Excludes all commercial, private, or customer-specific workflows and data handling.
- Includes quick setup and demo commands for local testing.
- Provides clear boundaries and guidance on community edition capabilities.
